title: Operator requirements: headless Auth0 enrollment, navigation authorization, and feedback reliability

conditions.description: Reconcile existing work and create/update canonical implementation tasks for JarvisClient headless authentication. Operator requires RFC 8628 OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant via existing Auth0 account identity, token persistence and refresh; verification URL and user code for authorization on another machine; preserve browser flow; unattended startup/reconnection/refresh under systemd; correct authorization expiry, denial, cancellation, interval/slow_down/backoff behavior; actionable reauthorization diagnostics; installation, enrollment and systemd docs. Target DOOM, bare-metal Proxmox VE Debian 13 x86-64, existing self-contained Linux CLI, TUI not required. Avoid separate machine identity/auth architecture absent evidence. Verify current Auth0 application configuration prerequisites, keep tokens/codes out of logs and service credentials protected; include independent review, protocol negative tests and unattended restart/reconnect evidence. No live host modification or Auth0 configuration change implied by planning; separately identify operator enrollment/config prerequisites. Return task IDs, priorities, acceptance criteria and dispatch/dependencies.

conditions.description: Reconcile existing work and create/update canonical Browser Bridge navigation authorization tasks. Operator observed Auth0 app list -> Jarvis Client settings same-origin navigation: BrowserExecutionError:OutcomeUnknown:RegistrationChangedDuringExecution, followed by needsReauthorization; similar on Proxmox dashboard. Distinguish document lifetime from authorization lifetime: same-origin navigation within existing scope invalidates stale execution handles without unnecessary authorization revocation. Preserve origin/scope boundaries, explicit revocation, navigation races and uncertain-effect non-replay; no silent automatic retries. Investigate actual root cause, test full-document navigation, SPA navigation where relevant, cross-origin, revocation, in-flight operations, new document execution, and return task IDs/priority/acceptance and dispatch/dependencies.

Reconcile existing work and create/update canonical feedback infrastructure tasks. Operator observed two feedback submissions fail TelemetryQuotaExceeded: diagnostic disk budget reached; optional retention maintenance required. Listing fails TelemetryUnavailable: SQLite timed out; diagnostic outcome unknown. Investigate retention, contention, transaction and failure semantics; optional diagnostics must not indefinitely prevent actionable feedback submission. Evaluate separate durable feedback records from disposable telemetry with independent retention/storage budgets; preserve existing feedback data/provenance, do not delete as workaround, avoid retrying uncertain writes without reconciliation. Test quota exhaustion, contention, maintenance, concurrency, migration/recovery and bounded behavior; document operational retention. Return task IDs/priority/acceptance and dispatch/dependencies. Additional Interpreter evidence: task_overview read exceeded 921600-byte transport cap (1014827 bytes); track separately if not covered, prefer bounded/paginated canonical reads. All three workstreams independent of current W7/W14 release HOLD, preserve Scheduler OFF and existing release qualification requirements; exploit parallelism safely.
